title: Closeness to his mother and friends leaving for the North
summary: He recaps his musical beginnings, says he was close to his mother, and describes his gang moving north.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, Freddie, so really that's where your musical beginnings were -- that you would hear the theaters --
Mm hmm.
-- and you would hear those bands -- the Jenkins' bands --
Yes. Yeah.
-- and you had yourself a ukelele --
Yeah. Right.
-- and you would be with your mother when she was singing --
Yes. Yes.

Oh yeah. Very close.
Aw.
Very close. Yeah.
So, you were sad when you had to go up north, really -- in a way, I would guess -- you were torn.

Yeah, yeah. But you know, my friends used to leave, you know, all the buddies I used to play with -- they all left. And I was about like the last one -- part of my gang, that I used to, you know, play with.

They'd went up to New York, more or less. They came up.

Yeah. And I just, like, saw them all off, you know.

No, not really. No.
